objective: Measure and reduce error on unseen position-controlled physical interactions through views and probes
reuse: Existing Gaussian material-attached renderer plus actual RGB-D sensor adapter
experiments.gaussian_active_design weighted physical hypotheses and predictive risk
primary_scope: Quasistatic deformation and reaction, not impact/friction-generalization claims
ambiguities: Occluded support footprint location, resolved through actual new-view RGB-D visibility
Hidden material heterogeneity with identical static appearance, resolved through position-controlled deformation

measurement_tracks.vision_only: RGB-D and prescribed tool positions; material ratios may be identifiable, absolute stiffness is not guaranteed
measurement_tracks.reaction_augmented: Same position inputs with explicit reaction-force measurement; compare only modality-matched policies

controls: Passive views of identical rest geometry must not identify hidden material
Homogeneous global stiffness scaling under zero known loads leaves position-controlled geometry unchanged but changes reactions
Identical initial belief implies identical first action; adaptive claim requires conditioned sequential evidence
Probe runs reset to same initial equilibrium; no unmodeled persistent contact history
metrics: world position and rigid-aligned deformation separately
reaction-force response in declared observable setting
predictive coverage and proper scores; interval width separate from measured error
actual held-response improvement versus predicted risk reduction
numerical failures and full declared cohort coverage
gates: Development-only mechanics mesh/order/refinement and sensor visibility qualification
Choose design/query distribution without final test-response access
Freeze hypotheses, likelihood/noise, policies, fixed baseline, splits and code
Generate and seal independent test truths/responses after protocol commitment
Only selected query observation released to each policy; no actual unselected outcomes available
Report independent object-level paired comparisons and every declared failure
nonclaims: No unique-parameter recovery from unidentifiable measurements
No physical improvement inferred from posterior shrinkage alone
No novel-active-policy superiority assumed before evaluation
No physically accurate rendering claim established by cartoon or pointcloud preview
